elements.name: Parent User
elements.rationale: Role checks and frontend-to-backend route bindings show a distinct parent role interacting with authentication, child management, user stats, and video management services.

elements.name: Child User
elements.rationale: Role checks and bound client calls show a distinct child role using child login and child-facing video/subprofile features.

elements.name: Administrator
elements.rationale: Admin-specific role checks evidence a separate external actor that can list users, change roles, and delete users.

elements.name: Authentication Service
elements.rationale: The auth router is mounted as one backend service and implements registration, multiple login flows, current-user lookup, and password change with reads/writes to user and child profile data.

elements.name: Child Profile Service
elements.rationale: The subprofiles router is mounted as one coherent service for child profile CRUD, video approval/request workflows, and search/watch history handling over child profile and video records.

elements.name: Video Service
elements.rationale: The videos router is mounted as one service that uploads, lists, retrieves, streams, updates, deletes, likes, and comments on videos while reading/writing video records.

elements.name: User Profile and Administration Service
elements.rationale: The users router is mounted as one service for profile retrieval/update, parent stats, and admin user management, backed by reads and writes to user, child profile, and video data.

elements.name: Users Database
elements.rationale: The User mongoose model is mapped to the users MongoDB collection, and multiple services read from and write to that persisted collection.

elements.name: Child Profiles Database
elements.rationale: The ChildProfile mongoose model is mapped to the childprofiles MongoDB collection, which is persistently read and updated by auth, child profile, and user-related services.

elements.name: Videos Database
elements.rationale: The Video mongoose model is mapped to the videos MongoDB collection, and the video and related services persistently query and update it.

elements.name: Uploaded Media Files
elements.rationale: Multer disk storage, directory creation, and static file serving facts show uploaded images and videos are stored on the server filesystem under uploads directories.

elements.name: Browser Local Storage
elements.rationale: Frontend web storage access facts show persistent client-side storage of auth token, user data, and cookie banner dismissal state in localStorage.
elements.uncertainty_note: This datastore is on the client device rather than the backend, but it is still a persistent store relevant to the system DFD. [adapter: dropped unresolvable fact ids ['F846b350']]
